completion_decisions: Digitize and register the 16 Figure-1 wind-resource markers because author numeric arrays are absent.
Use periodic monotone cubic Hermite interpolation as specified by the paper.
Use a declared piecewise-linear 1.5MW curve normalized to the paper 42 percent isolated capacity-factor anchor.
Reconstruct the unspecified gradient scheme as deterministic bounded coordinate-gradient trials for the paper's 190 iterations.
Flatten candidate, turbine, and direction work onto one persistent CPU team while keeping reductions and commits ordered.
missing_information: gradient-search update, step, and termination rules
author numerical quadrature, seed, and search history

paper.authors: Matthew A. Lackner and Christopher N. Elkinton
paper.title: An Analytical Framework for Offshore Wind Farm Layout Optimization

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the analytical framework and two-turbine demonstration; not author-source or exact 190-step replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: both turbines lie in x=[1600,10000]m and y=[-5000,5000]m; coincident hubs are excluded

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct continuous coordinates with bound projection for reconstructed search trials

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: LCOE, capital, AEP, capacity factor, wake loss, physical FES, timings, worker receipt, feasibility, and scientific hash

paper_native_cases.resolution: one two-turbine offshore rectangular opportunity-set example with printed initial and final layouts

parameters.resolution: 1.5MW, D=77m, CT=0.8, wake kappa=0.04, stated turbine/support/transmission/O&M/FCR costs, digitized wind resource, calibrated curve

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 190 iterations; every complete two-turbine LCOE call counts once; reconstructed search uses 1521 physical evaluations

update_order.resolution: parallel eight-neighbor coordinate trials, fixed-order value reductions, deterministic best commit, and step halving without improvement

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen/RSS wakes scale directional Weibull c; 1.5MW linear curve; string cable, support, turbine, O&M, and fixed-charge cost model

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: periodic PCHIP of 16 directional c, k, and frequency markers; shore-distance c scaling; 360x160 deterministic quadrature

validation.h6_scope: complete 190-iteration, 1521-physical-evaluation search with 17 observed workers and 1663 percent CPU
validation.h5_scope: independent cost equations and six printed LCOE, capital, capacity-factor, and wake-loss anchors
